content: Apply the user-authorized destructive SC0008 startup-governance replacement under D0029. Establish a canonical startup-resolution decision so the active stable harness product slug comes only from system/developer runtime instruction context, Codex declares exactly codex, model/template/backend/build/session/thread/prompt identifiers are rejected, no agent CLI or process/environment/filesystem inference is attempted, and the Git-aware Nix development environment precedes every repository executable or tool/version probe. Preserve Git evidence, provide no compatibility path, verify all current surfaces, then return M0110/W0112 to a newly scaffolded successor.

Content revisions 7db7bcfacb99ace087cbfd7a8a18b82a302be286, 73b471fe198429c6c9afc49f65fd750ecc75441d, and a7e370d68c660a1d42210631641bef0d3406cf91 establish D0031 and the destructive SC0008 startup contract. start-work resolves the stable harness product from system/developer runtime instruction context before ordinary work, requires codex for Codex, forbids agent CLI and process/environment/filesystem discovery, and puts every non-Git/Nix executable or version probe behind the Git-aware Nix environment. Missing tools route through the repository Nix declaration first; Nix owns only clear, reproducible, stable tool-version identity, materialization, and exposure, while later manage-toolchain updates may deliberately evolve versions. Helper/skill tests passed 9/9, the Codex skill validator passed, routing passed 89 cases plus 34/34 self-tests, agent-record self-tests passed 197 cases, semantic-change edits passed 23/23, explicit wrong-subject rejection and codex preflight passed, and Nix-provided rg/Python/CMake/Ninja/CTest probes passed.

SC0008 applies at effective revision a7e370d68c660a1d42210631641bef0d3406cf91 with D0031 as canonical owner. The breaking migration has no compatibility, legacy-length, host-first, identity-inference, or model/template/CLI provenance route. Tool versions are stable and reproducible at a given revision rather than permanently immutable; later changes use manage-toolchain and preserve Nix's narrow provision boundary. The governance session closes after routing this project-governance reconstruction as a dark roast to docs/architecture/agent-startup-resolution.md, and product focus transfers atomically to S0112-20260901-003-m0110-w0112-post-startup-governance for the unchanged W0112 Exit Gate.
